title: Cloud pilot
intro: Builder experiment with one fixed page template. This does not publish a site.
name: Project name
paused: The pilot is paused. Saved content is still available to view.
noCreate: You do not have permission to create a project in this workspace.
readOnly: You have view access. Ask the project owner for edit access.
loadError: This pilot could not be opened. Its saved content has not been changed.
previewHint: Preview of your current changes. Save to keep them in cloud.
imageHint: Use a public HTTPS image URL. This pilot does not upload or store image files.
conflict: Someone saved a newer version. Your changes are still here. Load the latest version to continue.
reload: Discard my changes and load latest

errors.generic: Could not save. Your changes are still here. Check your connection and try again.
errors.create: Could not open the pilot. Check your access and try again.
errors.PILOT_CONFLICT: A newer version was saved. Your changes have been kept. Load the latest version before saving again.
errors.PILOT_DISABLED: The pilot is paused. Your changes have not been saved.
errors.PILOT_INVALID_CONTENT: Add a title and check the field lengths.
errors.PILOT_INVALID_IMAGE: Use a public HTTPS image URL and add an image description.
errors.PILOT_INVALID_LINK: Add both button text and a public HTTPS button URL, or leave both empty.
errors.PILOT_LIMIT: This account has too many projects for this pilot.
errors.PILOT_INVALID_NAME: Enter a project name between 1 and 80 characters.
errors.PILOT_DAMAGED: This pilot needs repair before it can be edited. Its content has not been changed.
errors.PILOT_UNSUPPORTED: This template version cannot be opened in the pilot.

connectionError: The cloud connection could not be refreshed. Your unsaved changes are still here. Try again before saving.
storageError: This browser cannot keep an unsaved draft. Save before leaving this page.
onePilot: Each builder can have one pilot in this workspace.
offline: Offline. You can keep editing. Reconnect to save.
